    HOW IT WORKS

    Order online.
    Delivered direct.

    No warehouse stop. Your order goes from our supplier straight to your site or door.

    1. 01

      Choose and pay

      Add products to your cart and pay through secure Shopify checkout. Prices are all-inclusive in AUD, and delivery is shown before you pay: A$11, or free over A$100.

    2. 02

      We place the order

      Your order goes to our supplier automatically, with your delivery address. No calls or emails needed.

    3. 03

      Shipped direct

      The supplier ships straight to you. Most orders take about 2 to 3 weeks, which is the supplier’s estimate. We share tracking once we have it.

    4. 04

      We sort any problem

      If something arrives damaged, faulty or wrong, or doesn’t arrive, contact FI and we deal with the supplier for you.

    BUYING FOR A JOB?

    Need a larger quantity or something not in the shop? Send us your list and we’ll reply with a quote, usually within 48 hours. Your consumer rights apply to every order.

    PRICING

    Simple prices.
    No hidden fees.

    We buy from our supplier and add our margin to the price you see. That margin is how FI makes money: no subscriptions, no sign-up fees.

    1. 01

      Shop prices

      From A$3.95. The price on the product is what you pay, plus delivery: A$11, or free on orders over A$100.

    2. 02

      Founding customers: 10% off

      Use code FOUNDING10 on your first order. First 20 orders only, until 31 October.

    3. 03

      Trade: 15% off

      For plumbers, builders, cabinet makers and renovators. Send us your business name and ABN and we email your trade code. Apply for trade pricing ↗

    4. 04

      Big or custom jobs

      Send us your list for a quote. Optional warehouse inspection before dispatch: 10% of the product price. Build a project list ↗

    TRADE ACCOUNT

    Apply for trade pricing with your business name and ABN. One of the founders replies within 48 hours.
